directions: Aim for line-F1 >= 0.80 with NO part-specific optimization: generality over the parts in the mix.
No SKU/family/part-id/filename-dependent code, thresholds or special cases anywhere in the engine (E3 never receives filename tokens or metadata counts, plan amendment 4).
Primary production gate: per-bend correctness given CAD (formed/not, flange length, angle, PASS/FAIL with ~zero false PASS).

Labelling conventions: a joggle is 2 bends; formed 15 deg tabs count; a fold interrupted by windows or reliefs folding the same two plates is one line; the line locus is the visible-surface apex (amendment 6a).
Gold11 human labels are under audit: until the owner signs off, report G2(a) against BOTH the human Gold11 and ai_bend_lines_gold11_relabel_v1 if present; never replace silently.
